limitations: Earth and Moon elevations use different reference surfaces, so they are shown but not subtracted.
The Moon has no atmosphere: pressure, air temperature and humidity have no lunar equivalent and are not compared.
The Pamir is a weak analog for lunar polar lighting (grazing sunlight, permanently shadowed craters).
